Why It Sells

What buyers love about Mount Louisa.

Elevated blocks with breezes and outlooks, modern family homes, and quick access to the Ring Road, Lavarack Barracks, the university and the hospital. Demand consistently outpaces supply in the pockets locals love most.

  • Family homes with pools, sheds and side access in demand
  • Strong interest from upgraders and defence families
  • Premium streets regularly attract multiple offers
  • Home of two of Paul and Mel's 2026 million dollar sales
